title: Filtered colimit of smooth algebras ('PT holds')
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\Lambda$ a commutative $R$-algebra. *$\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras* (in Stacks, Smoothing Ring Maps: *PT holds for $R\to\Lambda$*) if there are a small filtered category $J$, a functor $j\mapsto B_j$ from $J$ to the category of commutative $R$-algebras (the transition maps $B_j\to B_{j'}$ being homomorphisms of $R$-algebras) such that every $B_j$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $\iota_j:B_j\to\Lambda$ such that $(\Lambda,(\iota_j)_{j\in J})$ is a colimit of the diagram $j\mapsto B_j$ in the category of commutative $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Section Tag 07F1 (section-reduction), the sentence after Situation Tag 07F2 (situation-global): 'We say PT holds for R -> Lambda if Lambda is a filtered colimit of smooth R-algebras'
